name: 侠客行（老版/金庸群侠传）
english_name: Ode to Gallantry (Old Edition / Heroes of Jin Yong)
english_description: A wuxia MUD whose map is a genuine Jin Yong multi-novel mashup rather than a single-book setting: alongside the standard Huashan/Wudang/Shaolin/Beggars' Sect roster shared with the jyqxc/jyqxc2 family, it includes Tianlongsi (the Tianlong Monastery from Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils), Heimuya (Black Wood Cliff, home of the Sun Moon Holy Cult from The Smiling, Proud Wanderer), Taohua/Peach Blossom Island (Legend of the Condor Heroes), and a Mystic Dragon Cult hall (The Deer and the Cauldron). One archival curiosity: extracted from a mislabeled ".rar" that is actually a POSIX tar file, it also carries an unused adm/obj/master.lpc byte-identical to the jyqxc/fy2mg/xkx2017 framework master, but the game actually boots from a different file, /adm/single/master, so this look-alike was never really loaded — a red herring for lineage-tracing rather than a real shared codebase link.
